}

#================================================================================#
# LCLS MPS PV template for Central Node Ignore Conditions                        #
# Macro description:                                                             #
#   - NAME       : Condition Name                                                #
#   - DESC       : Condition Description                                         #
#   - ID         : Condition ASYN ID                                             #
#   - BASE       : Central Node Prefix                                           #
#================================================================================#
record(bi, "$(BASE):$(NAME)") {
  field(DESC, "$(DESC)")
  field(DTYP, "asynUInt32Digital")
  field(SCAN, "1 second")
  field(ZNAM, "False")
  field(ONAM, "True")
  field(ZSV, "NO_ALARM")
  field(OSV, "MAJOR")
  field(INP, "@asynMask(CENTRAL_NODE $(ID) 1 0)MPS_IGNORE_CONDITION")
}

#================================================================================#
# LCLS MPS PV template for Central Node Faults                                   #
# Macro description:                                                             #
#   - PV         : Device Input PV Prefix                                        #
#   - ID         : Fault  ID                                                     #
#   - DESC       : Fault Description                                             #
#================================================================================#

record(longin, "$(PV)") {
  field(DESC, "$(DESC)")
  field(DTYP, "asynInt32")
  field(SCAN, "1 second")
  field(INP,  "@asynMask(CENTRAL_NODE $(ID) 0)MPS_FAULT")
}
record(bi, "$(PV)_IGNORED") {
  field(DESC, "$(DESC) Ignored")
  field(DTYP, "asynUInt32Digital")
  field(SCAN, "1 second")
  field(ZNAM, "Not Ignored")
  field(ONAM, "Ignored")
  field(INP,  "@asynMask(CENTRAL_NODE $(ID) 1 0)MPS_FAULT_IGNORED")
}
record(bi, "$(PV)_SCMPS") {
  field(DESC, "$(DESC) Faulted")
  field(DTYP, "asynUInt32Digital")
  field(SCAN, "1 second")
  field(ZNAM, "Not Faulted")
  field(ONAM, "Faulted")
  field(INP,  "@asynMask(CENTRAL_NODE $(ID) 1 0)MPS_FAULT_FAULTED")
}
record(bi, "$(PV)_ACTIVE") {
  field(DESC, "$(DESC) Active")
  field(DTYP, "asynUInt32Digital")
  field(SCAN, "1 second")
  field(ZNAM, "Not Active")
  field(ONAM, "Active")
  field(INP,  "@asynMask(CENTRAL_NODE $(ID) 1 0)MPS_FAULT_ACTIVE")
}
record(bi, "$(PV)_SCBYPS") {
  field(DESC, "Bypass Status")
  field(SCAN, "1 second")
  field(DTYP, "asynUInt32Digital")
  field(ZNAM, "Not Bypassed")
  field(ONAM, "Bypassed")
  field(ZSV, "NO_ALARM")
  field(OSV, "MAJOR")
  field(INP, "@asynMask(CENTRAL_NODE $(ID) 1 1)MPS_FAULT_BYPS")
}
record(longout, "$(PV)_SCBYPD") {
  field(DESC, "Bypass duration in seconds")
  field(DTYP, "asynInt32")
  field(EGU, "Seconds")
  field(VAL, "0")
  field(PINI, "YES")
  field(OUT, "@asyn(CENTRAL_NODE $(ID) 1)MPS_FAULT_BYPEXPDATE")
  field(ASG,  "$(ASG2)")

record(longin, "$(PV)_SCBYPT") {

  field(SCAN, "1 second")

  field(PINI, "YES")

#================================================================================#
# LCLS-II MPS PV template for LCLS-I operator displays                           #
# Macro description:                                                             #
#   - P_DEV       : Record name prefix i.e. CBLM:UNDH:1375                       #
#   - FAULT       : Fault name from database (I0)                                #
#   - R_DEV       : fault descriptor name (LOSS or CURRENT, etc.                 #
#   - EGU         : Engineering units                                            #
#================================================================================#

record(ai, "$(P_DEV):$(FAULT)_$(R_DEV)") {
    field(DESC, "Analog input value")
    field(DTYP, "$(DTYP)")
    field(EGU, "$(EGU)")
    field(SCAN, ".1 second")
    field(INP, "$(INPV) NPP NMS")
    field(FLNK, "$(P_DEV):$(FAULT)_$(R_DEV)NORMH")
    info(autosaveFields, "AOFF ASLO EGU")
}
record(calc, "$(P_DEV):$(FAULT)_$(R_DEV)NORMH") {
    field(DESC, "Normalized analog value")
    field(INPA, "$(P_DEV):$(FAULT)_$(R_DEV) NPP NMS")
    field(INPB, "$(P_DEV):$(FAULT)_T0_LC1_H_RBV")
    field(CALC, "B=0?A:100*A/B")
    field(FLNK, "$(P_DEV):$(FAULT)_$(R_DEV)NORML")
    field(EGU, "%")
    field(SCAN, "Passive")
}
record(calc, "$(P_DEV):$(FAULT)_$(R_DEV)NORML") {
    field(DESC, "Normalized analog value")
    field(INPA, "$(P_DEV):$(FAULT)_$(R_DEV) NPP NMS")
    field(INPB, "$(P_DEV):$(FAULT)_T0_LC1_L_RBV")
    field(CALC, "B=0?A:100*A/B")
    field(EGU, "%")
    field(SCAN, "Passive")
}

#================================================================================#
# LCLS MPS PV template for Central Node Analog Devices - 1 per fault type        #
# Macro description:                                                             #
#   - P          : Device Input PV Prefix                                        #
#   - ID         : Device ID                                                     #
#   - INT        : Integrator number                                             #
#================================================================================#
record(bi, "$(P)_SCBYPS") {
  field(DESC, "Bypass Status")
  alias("$(P)_FLT_SCBYPS")
  field(SCAN, "1 second")
  field(DTYP, "asynInt32")
  field(ZNAM, "Not Bypassed")
  field(ONAM, "Bypassed")
  field(ZSV, "NO_ALARM")
  field(OSV, "MAJOR")
  field(INP, "@asyn(CENTRAL_NODE $(ID) $(INT))MPS_ANALOG_DEVICE_BYPS")
}

record(longout, "$(P)_SCBYPD") {
  alias("$(P)_FLT_SCBYPD")
  field(DESC, "Bypass duration in seconds")
  field(DTYP, "asynInt32")
  field(VAL, "0")
  field(PINI, "YES")
  field(OUT, "@asyn(CENTRAL_NODE $(ID) $(INT))MPS_ANALOG_DEVICE_BYPEXPDATE")
  field(ASG,  "$(ASG2)")
}

record(longin, "$(P)_SCBYPT") {
  field(DESC, "Remaining bypass duration is seconds")
  field(DTYP, "asynInt32")
  alias("$(P)_FLT_SCBYPT")
  field(EGU, "Seconds")
  field(SCAN, "1 second")
  field(VAL, "0")
  field(PINI, "YES")
  field(INP, "@asyn(CENTRAL_NODE $(ID) $(INT))MPS_ANALOG_DEVICE_REMAINING_BYPTIME")
}

record(stringin, "$(P)_SCBYP_END") {
  field(DESC, "Bypass Expiration Date/Time String")
  alias("$(P)_FLT_SCBYP_END")
  field(DTYP, "asynOctetRead")
  field(SCAN, "1 second")
  field(VAL, "Invalid")
  field(PINI, "YES")
  field(INP, "@asyn(CENTRAL_NODE $(BYPID) $(INT))MPS_ANALOG_DEVICE_BYPEXPDATE_STRING")
}

record(bi, "$(P)_SCBYPV") {
  field(DESC, "Bypass Value")
  alias("$(P)_FLT_SCBYPV")
  field(SCAN, "1 second")
  field(ZNAM, "OK")
  field(ONAM, "OK")
  field(ZSV, "NO_ALARM")
  field(OSV, "MAJOR")
  field(VAL, "0")
}

#================================================================================#
# LCLS MPS PV template for Central Node Analog Faults - 1 per fault              #
# Macro description:                                                             #
#   - P          : Device Input PV Prefix                                        #
#   - CR         : Crate Number                                                  #
#   - CA         : Card Number                                                   #
#   - CH         : Channel Number                                                #
#   - ID         : Device ID                                                     #
#   - MASK       : Device State Mask                                             #
#================================================================================#

record(bi, "$(P)_SCMPSC") {
  field(DESC, "Crate[$(CR)], Card[$(CA)], Channel[$(CH)]")
  field(DTYP, "asynUInt32Digital")
  field(SCAN, "1 second")
  field(ZNAM, "IS_OK")
  field(ONAM, "IS_EXCEEDED")
  field(ZSV, "NO_ALARM")
  field(OSV, "MAJOR")
  field(INP, "@asynMask(CENTRAL_NODE $(ID) $(MASK) 0)MPS_ANALOG_DEVICE")
}

record(bi, "$(P)_SCMPS") {
  field(DESC, "CR[$(CR)], CA[$(CA)], CH[$(CH)] Latched Value")
  field(DTYP, "asynUInt32Digital")
  field(SCAN, "1 second")
  field(ZNAM, "IS_OK")
  field(ONAM, "IS_EXCEEDED")
  field(ZSV, "NO_ALARM")
  field(OSV, "MAJOR")
  field(INP, "@asynMask(CENTRAL_NODE $(ID) $(MASK) 0)MPS_ANALOG_DEVICE_LATCHED")
}

record(bo, "$(P)_SCUNLH") {
  field(DESC, "CR[$(CR)], CA[$(CA)], CH[$(CH)] Unlatch")
  field(DTYP, "asynUInt32Digital")
  field(OUT, "@asynMask(CENTRAL_NODE $(ID) $(MASK) 0)MPS_ANALOG_DEVICE_UNLATCH")
}

#================================================================================#
# LCLS MPS PV template for Central Node Analog Devices - 1 per fault type        #
# Macro description:                                                             #
#   - APP_ID     : MPS APP ID                                                    #
#   - TYPE       : App card type                                                 #
#   - LOCA       : link node crate location                                      #
#   - SLOT       : crate slot number                                             #
#   - ID         : ASYN driver (database) ID                                     #

  field(DESC, "$(TYPE) [$(LOCA) S$(SLOT) ID$(APP_ID)]")
  field(DTYP, "asynUInt32Digital")
  field(SCAN, "1 second")
  field(ZNAM, "OFFLINE")
  field(ONAM, "ONLINE")

#================================================================================#
# LCLS-II MPS PV template for Software Watchdog Inputs                           #
# Macro description:                                                             #
#   - P  : MPS Prefix                                                            #
#================================================================================#
record(compress, "$(P):FPGA_UPTIMECNT_BUFF") {
  field(DESC, "Circular Bufffer")
  field(SCAN, "1 second")
  field(INP,  "$(P):FPGA_UPTIMECNT")
  field(ALG,  "Circular Buffer")
  field(NSAM, "10")
  field(FLNK, "$(P):FPGA_UPTIMECNT_BUFMAX")
  field(ASG,  "NOWRITE")
}
record(compress, "$(P):FPGA_UPTIMECNT_BUFMAX") {
  field(DESC, "Bufffer Max")
  field(INP,  "$(P):FPGA_UPTIMECNT_BUFF.VAL NPP MS")
  field(ALG,  "N to 1 High Value")
  field(N,    "10")
  field(FLNK, "$(P):FPGA_UPTIMECNT_BUFMIN")
  field(ASG,  "NOWRITE")
}

record(compress, "$(P):FPGA_UPTIMECNT_BUFMIN") {
  field(DESC, "Bufffer Min")
  field(INP,  "$(P):FPGA_UPTIMECNT_BUFF.VAL NPP MS")
  field(ALG,  "N to 1 Low Value")
  field(N,    "10")
  field(FLNK, "$(P):FPGA_UPTIMECNT_WDOG_CALC")
  field(ASG,  "NOWRITE")
}
record(calc, "$(P):FPGA_UPTIMECNT_WDOG_CALC") {
  field(DESC, "Stale data watchdog ")
  field(CALC, "(C=3)?0:((A = B) ?0:1)")
  field(INPA, "$(P):FPGA_UPTIMECNT_BUFMIN.VAL")
  field(INPB, "$(P):FPGA_UPTIMECNT_BUFMAX.VAL")
  field(INPC, "$(P):FPGA_UPTIMECNT_BUFF.SEVR")
  field(FLNK, "$(P):FPGA_UPTIMECNT_WDOG")
  field(ASG,  "NOWRITE")
}
record(bo, "$(P):FPGA_UPTIMECNT_WDOG") {
    field(DESC, "Input CALC")
    field(PINI, "YES")	
    field(SCAN, "Passive")
    field(DOL, "$(P):FPGA_UPTIMECNT_WDOG_CALC")
    field(ZNAM, "ERROR")
    field(ONAM, "OK")
    field(ZSV, "MAJOR")
    field(OSV, "NO_ALARM")
    field(OMSL, "closed_loop")
}

# LCLS-II MPS PV template for read-only registers                                #
# Macro description:                                                             #
#   - P     : Record name prefix                                                 #
#   - R     : Record name                                                        #
#   - DESC  : Description                                                        #
#   - PORT  : Asyn port name                                                     #
#   - ADDR  : Asyn parameter list number (0: AppBay0, 1: AppBay1, 2: MpsBase)    #
#   - PARAM : Asyn parameter name                                                #
#================================================================================#

record(longin, "$(P):APP_ID") {
    field(DESC, "Application ID")
    field(SCAN, "I/O Intr")
    field(PINI, "NO")
    field(DTYP, "asynInt32")
    field(INP,  "@asyn($(PORT),2)APP_ID")
}#================================================================================#
